title: Corresync
description: Local-first MCP for provider-neutral mail, calendars, and tasks with isolated accounts and guarded writes.
shortDescription: Use guarded local mail, calendar, and task tools
longDescription: Corresync brings isolated mail, calendar, and task routes into one guarded local MCP server. Outlook, Microsoft 365, JMAP, IMAP/SMTP, and CalDAV routes are included; Gmail and Google Calendar remain disabled pending production OAuth approval, and task-provider routes remain unavailable until their individual contracts ship. Corresync runs on your device over stdio, keeps authentication in an explicit local browser or approved credential store, and requires preview-before-commit writes.
author: Corresync contributors
requirements: Install the matching Corresync CLI release and make corr available on PATH.
Configure and authenticate each account explicitly in a local terminal before use.

effects.networkScope: Only providers explicitly configured and authenticated by the signed-in user.
effects.secretPolicy: The bundle contains no account, credential, token, cookie, or private configuration data.

surfaces.limitation: Local Codex sessions only; hosted ChatGPT cannot reach this stdio server.
Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, and VS Code must run where corr is installed.
Local Gemini CLI only; the extension does not bundle corr.
Local Kiro IDE only; Kiro Web and remote sandboxes are unsupported.
The MCPB contains release binaries but never contains configured accounts or authentication state.
